item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'edges':{'a>b':{},'x>y':{'role':'admin'},'f>r':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}\\ncases=[({'from':'a','to':'z'},'blocked'),({'from':'x','to':'y','role':'user','attempts':'bad'},'permission'),({'from':'f','to':'r'},'retry_limit'),({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':True},'retry_limit'),({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':-1},'retry_limit'),({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':0},'ok'),({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':1},'ok'),({'from':'f','to':'r','attempts':2},'retry_limit'),({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True},'ok')]\\nfor req,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got['reason']==want,(req,got,want); assert req==rb and p==pb\\nprint(json.dumps([evaluate(r,p) for r,_ in cases]))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json') as f:r=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f:p=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(x,p) for x in r]\\nwith open('report.json') as f:stored=json.load(f)\\nassert actual==stored,(actual,stored)\\nprint(json.dumps(actual))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
